profile.headline: Software Engineer |  2x AWS Certified
profile.summary:
Hello,

I’m Anthony, a software engineer with a unique background in both biology and computer science. I earned my B.S. in Biology from Montclair State University and later completed a B.S. in Computer Science at Oregon State University. Over the past few years, I’ve worked as a developer focusing on Oracle database development, where I’ve honed a detail-oriented and data-driven approach to building solutions. I'm also AWS Certified as both a Cloud Practitioner and Solutions Architect – Associate.

company.name: College of Engineering – Oregon State University

positions.title: Undergraduate Learning Assistant (CS 352 - Introduction to Usability Engineering)
positions.description: Held office hours via Microsoft Teams weekly.  Graded and provided feedback for usability engineering projects.  Coordinated with students and teachers in the course to mediate proper course information.

positions.title: Undergraduate Learning Assistant (CS 340 - Introduction to Databases)
positions.description: Co-authored the osu-cs340-ecampus /nodejs-starter-app for students enrolled at Oregon State University for CS 340 (Introduction to Databases). The guide covers topics on how to dynamically implement the CRUD principles for a responsive full stack server/website.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Flask and +6 skills

positions.title: Lead Undergraduate Learning Assistant (CS 161 - Introduction to Computer Science)
positions.description: Monitored workflow of grading responsibilities. Provided supervisory support to other learning assistants in the course. Setup work spaces for course projects, published grades, and sent out weekly reminders to students for due dates

certifications.title: Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers (BLS)

certifications.title: Amazon Web Services Solutions Architect Associate

projects.title: Kamuirpg.com
projects.description: Implemented a companion website for my video game I'm coding.  Site is built in React, and utilizes AWS CloudFront, Route 53, and S3 for static web hosting that is cached and HTTPS secured.

projects.title: Population generator micro-service
projects.description: Created a population generator that is able to gather real data via census.gov with Python and libraries like Tkinter. Users can choose their selection of state and year via drop down menus and can choose to export and / or display results. The program can read input and output for csv files and can handle basic communication with other microservices via csv files.
